tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should be abide as per the terms & condition attached documents.
The bidder should quote the rate with inclusive of all taxes, Freight, Packing & Forwarding, and Insurance etc
Manufacturer / authorized dealer certificate for particular tender should be attached as per our format attached in tender documents.
The authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders without giving any reasons
The EMD amount mentioned in the tender document need to be paid compulsorily and MSME Certificate or any other certificates are not considered for EMD exemption

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Similar suppliers list with purchase order and satisfactory certificate should be attached
Bidder should attach last three years IT returns, PAN, GST, Balance Sheet with CA certification and Company Registration Certificate
